Filter low-abundance occurrences relative to total variant read count

Source: R/vtamR_fun.R
filter_occurrence_variant.Rd

Filter potential false positives arising from tag-jumps or low-level inter-sample contamination.

When by_replicate = FALSE, occurrences are removed when the ratio read_count / total read count of the ASV in the dataset is lower than cutoff.

When by_replicate = TRUE, occurrences are removed when the ratio read_count / total read count of the ASV within the same replicate is lower than cutoff.

A warning is issued if the total read count of an ASV after filtering falls below min_read_count_prop of its original abundance, as this may indicate that the cutoff value is too stringent.

By default, a single global cutoff value (cutoff) is applied to all ASVs. Alternatively, ASV-specific cutoff values can be provided via asv_specific_cutoffs (data frame or CSV file). When both are provided, the global cutoff is used when no ASV-specific cutoff is available or when the ASV-specific cutoff is lower than the global value.

Usage

filter_occurrence_variant(
  read_count,
  cutoff = NULL,
  asv_specific_cutoffs = NULL,
  outfile = NULL,
  lost_asv_file = NULL,
  by_replicate = FALSE,
  sep = ",",
  min_read_count_prop = 0.7,
  log_file = NULL
)

Arguments

read_count

Data frame or path to a CSV file with the following columns: asv_id, sample, replicate, read_count, asv.

cutoff

Numeric value between 0 and 1 specifying the minimum proportion of reads required for an occurrence to be retained. Occurrences below this threshold are removed.

asv_specific_cutoffs

Data frame or path to a CSV file specifying ASV-specific cutoff values. May include a replicate column if by_replicate = TRUE.

outfile

Character string specifying the CSV file to write the output data frame. If NULL, no file is written.

lost_asv_file

Character string specifying the CSV file used to store information about ASVs whose retained read counts fall below min_read_count_prop of their original abundance.

by_replicate

Logical. If TRUE, compare read counts to ASV abundance within each replicate.

sep

Character string specifying the field separator used in input and output CSV files.

min_read_count_prop

Numeric value specifying the minimum proportion of total reads that must be retained per ASV after filtering. ASVs below this threshold trigger a warning.

log_file

Character string specifying the path to the CSV log file. The path is resolved with the following priority:

  1. the log_file argument, if explicitly provided by the user;

  2. the vtamR.log_file option set with options(vtamR.log_file = ...), if set;

  3. "vtamR_log.csv" in the current working directory, used as a last resort if neither of the above is set.

To disable logging entirely, set log_file = NA.

Value

Filtered read_count data frame.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
read_count_df <- filter_occurrence_variant(
  read_count = "read_counts.csv",
  cutoff = 0.001,
  asv_specific_cutoffs = "asv_cutoffs.csv",
  by_replicate = FALSE
)
} # }
